history_scope: Reviewed titles, show names, episode URLs, platform aliases, source dates and summaries in all 20 available canonical production editions before September 28. No same-day production or Q results were treated as novelty history.
review_scope: Fresh Q24 publisher-distributed episode descriptions, topic lists and chapters plus exact episode/show metadata. Audio was not played or transcribed. This review supports descriptions of the episodes' advertised topics, not independent confirmation of product performance or every statement in the audio.

reviews.audience_fit: Accessible explanation of desktop-agent vocabulary for knowledge workers and nontechnical agent users.
reviews.novelty_assessment: The only earlier Everyday AI record is episode 865 on open-source AI, with a different Buzzsprout episode identity and subject. Earlier agent-loop coverage is a different episode and publisher. Episode 871 and its present terminology-focused treatment are not repeated podcast selections in the reviewed history.
reviews.summary: Everyday AI introduces desktop-agent terminology, including goals, plans, loops, subagents and context delegation. The published topic list and chapter markers frame the episode as a vocabulary primer for understanding agent-based work rather than a conventional chatbot interaction.
reviews.why_it_matters: Shared vocabulary can help a team distinguish a task goal from a plan, an iterative loop and delegated subtasks before evaluating an agent workflow.
reviews.editorial_limitation: Reviewed publisher-distributed shownotes and chapters, not the audio or a hands-on product demonstration. Product-specific instructions and performance claims are not independently verified.

reviews.summary: AI for Humans discusses recent model releases through creative examples, including games, animation, 3D modeling and motion graphics. The episode's favorable model comparisons are the hosts' opinions; this selection emphasizes the advertised application examples rather than presenting those comparisons as independently established results.
reviews.why_it_matters: The chapter list offers a range of creative tasks to consider for experimentation, with a different emphasis from enterprise deployment or introductory agent vocabulary.
reviews.editorial_limitation: Shownotes and chapter review only; audio and linked demonstrations were not independently tested. Model rankings, pricing assertions and rumors are not adopted as factual conclusions.
